items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: And that's when I got Leon, Harvey, Henry and myself.

ctx.x: Well, he came here in 1923, Coleman did, with Mamie Smith. He came with Harvey Brooks. I hired Harvey to play in our little four piece group. I said, "Do you want to get a little band together?" Harvey said, "Yes, I'd like to stay here." I said, "Okay, we'll organize a little band."

Four pieces, which we did. And that's when I got Leon, Harvey, Henry and myself. Harvey was -- Lionel was a very fine little young fellow, but he just would go off and get drunk, and chasing he white gals and get put in jail.
